name: @jayyuen66/dsh-scrapling
description: Scrapling 网页抓取插件（dsh）：静态/浏览器抓取 + CSS/XPath 结构化抽取 + 选择器自愈 + capture_xhr 与会话网络历史 + 登录态存取 + Spider 爬虫，由常驻 Python 进程驱动。
author: JayYuen

scripts.check: npm run --loglevel=warn typecheck && npm run --loglevel=warn lint && npm run --loglevel=warn build:client && npm run --loglevel=warn build && npm run --loglevel=warn test && npm run --loglevel=warn fmt:check && npm run --loglevel=warn check:py
scripts.prepack: npm run --loglevel=warn build:client && npm run --loglevel=warn build
scripts.py:which: sh -c 'test -x _env/.venv/bin/python && echo "[py] 解释器：$PWD/_env/.venv/bin/python" || echo "[py] 解释器：PATH 上的 python3（本仓没有 _env/.venv，在伞根跑 pnpm py:setup）"'
scripts.face:py: npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -c "import pathlib,sys;MIN=6;fs=sorted(str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('py').rglob('*.py'));td=pathlib.Path('py/tests').is_dir();print('[face:py] bandit 与覆盖率量到的面：py/ 下 %d 份 *.py（下限 %d），py/tests/ 目录存在：%s' % (len(fs),MIN,td),flush=True);sys.exit('py/ 下只找到 %d 份 *.py，低于下限 %d：bandit 与 coverage 的分母已经空了，后面每一段都在量空气' % (len(fs),MIN) if len(fs)<MIN else 'py/tests/ 不是目录：coverage 的 --omit=py/tests/* 会连分母一起放宽，地板量的就成了虚高的那一面' if not td else 0)"
scripts.lint:py: npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m ruff check py/
scripts.fmt:py: npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m ruff format --check py/
scripts.cov:py: npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage erase && DSH_PY_COVERAGE=1 npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage run --parallel-mode py/tests/test_bridge.py && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage combine && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage report -m && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage erase
scripts.coverage:floor: npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage erase && DSH_PY_COVERAGE=1 npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage run --parallel-mode py/tests/test_bridge.py && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage combine && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage report --omit="py/tests/*" --fail-under=74 && npm run --loglevel=warn py -- -m coverage erase
scripts.check:py: npm run --loglevel=warn py:which && npm run --loglevel=warn face:py && npm run --loglevel=warn lint:py && npm run --loglevel=warn fmt:py && npm run --loglevel=warn typecheck:py && npm run --loglevel=warn test:py && npm run --loglevel=warn bandit:py && npm run --loglevel=warn coverage:floor
